title: Erasmus Mundus Journalism 2027-2029

compensation.value: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: full tuition waiver and EUR 1,400 per month for up to 24 months, plus health and liability insurance
compensation.evidence_quote: a full tuition waiver for both years and €1,400 per month for up to 24 months

about: Mundus Journalism, an Erasmus Mundus joint master's with a first year in Aarhus, accepts 2027-2029 applications from 1 November 2026 until 10 January 2027, 13:00 CET. About 10-15 Erasmus Mundus scholarships are expected, covering tuition and EUR 1,400 per month for up to 24 months.
requirements: Completed bachelor's degree, documented by the programme's cut-off date
Not eligible if already holding a master's of at least two years or a previous Erasmus Mundus scholarship
One application covers admission and scholarship consideration

upskill.name: the full course catalog
why: No course objective covers the stated requirements (a completed bachelor's degree and eligibility conditions); the best keyword hit (A007.04 AI for Social Media Marketing) matched only on 'media' and is marketing, not journalism.
The caption therefore links to the Academy catalog, not a specific course, and says so.
